current_rule: Patch files must preserve required columns and default to REVIEW_ONLY until Jojo approval.
Patch rows may not change page_id or phrase_id unless a separate explicit source-owned canonical-row proposal exists.
This batch may not contain APPROVED_FOR_IMPORT values at creation time.
Every visible linked row proposed later must resolve to exactly one canonical page or ask Jojo a question.
Place, restaurant, dish, street, route, and relationship/person pages need page-kind-aware copy and section shape.
Proper names must not get fake literal breakdowns; use name recognition when no reliable simple translation exists.
No hours, prices, schedules, awards, best claims, or current policy claims without durable source evidence.
No audio generation; exact audio reuse first, otherwise planned missing audio with disabled speaker state.
Avoid long runs of text-only sections; phrase rows/breakdowns should create learning interaction.
